caption: A sandbag on a low wall is punctured near its bottom, and a thin stream of sand runs out onto the ground while the bag slowly slumps.

sa.check: A sandbag sits on a low wall.
It is punctured near its bottom.
A thin stream of sand runs out onto the ground.
The puncture comes first, then the stream, then the slump.

pc.expect: The stream comes only from the hole and starts at the puncture.
pc.fail: It starts before the puncture; or comes from elsewhere; or the bag is punctured and nothing comes out.

pc.expect: The sand falls straight down and builds a small cone below.
pc.fail: It goes up; or sideways; or hangs.

pc.expect: The bag sags and wrinkles as it empties, and the sand runs as grains.
pc.fail: The bag is rigid; or the sand is liquid; or the bag inflates.

pc.expect: The stream continues and does not flow back.
pc.fail: Sand flows back in; or stops while the bag is still full; or the cone shrinks.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The bag and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The bag changes colour; or the wall changes; or the background rearranges.
